stem: The graph shows the altitude \(y\), in meters, of a weather balloon \(x\) minutes after it is released from a hilltop. If the balloon continues to rise at the same constant rate, how many minutes after it is released will it reach an altitude of 12,000 meters?
solution: From \((0, 1{,}500)\) to \((10, 4{,}500)\), the altitude rises 3,000 meters in 10 minutes: 300 meters per minute.

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is \(12{,}000 \div 300\), ignoring the starting altitude of 1,500 meters shown at \(x = 0\).
explanation.B: Correct. The rate is \(\frac{4{,}500 - 1{,}500}{10} = 300\) meters per minute, so \(1{,}500 + 300x = 12{,}000\) gives \(x = 35\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This adds the starting altitude instead of subtracting it: the balloon must climb \(12{,}000 - 1{,}500\) meters.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This uses a rate of 350 meters per minute; the graph rises 3,000 meters in 10 minutes, or 300 meters per minute.

verify:
x = symbols('x')
p = figure['points']
m = Rational(p[1]['y'] - p[0]['y'], p[1]['x'] - p[0]['x'])
assert m == 300 and p[0]['y'] == 1500
sol = solve(Eq(p[0]['y'] + m*x, 12000), x)
assert sol == [35]
ans = sol[0]
assert value(choices[answer]) == ans
assert all(value(choices[k]) != ans for k in choices if k != answer)
